title: RedactionRules
description: Public-safe JSON Schema for the redaction-rules YAML referenced by Task 030 / docs/16. The runtime YAML lives in a private, gitignored location and is intentionally NOT tracked in this public repo; this schema documents the shape of that file using placeholder examples only. No real endpoint host, deployment name, region, customer name, or secret pattern appears in this schema.

rules.description: Ordered list of redaction rules. Order matters: 'abort' rules MUST be evaluated before lossy transforms so a secret hit is never written to a redacted output.

id.description: Stable rule identifier (kebab-case). Greppable from audit reports.

category.description: Coarse rule category. Mirrors the Task 030 redaction-rule categories table.

detect.description: How the rule recognises a hit. Exactly one of 'regex' or 'field_names' is required.

regex.description: PCRE-style regex evaluated case-insensitively. Example placeholder: '<PATTERN-PLACEHOLDER>'. The real patterns live in the private rules YAML, not in this schema.

field_names.description: Exact field-name matches in structured records. Example placeholders only.

action.description: What to do when the detector hits.

replacement.description: Placeholder string used when action='replace'. Example: '<redacted>'. MUST be public-safe; no real values.

tiers.description: Tier-specific application of this rule. Each entry is one of: 'required' (rule MUST run), 'further-generalized' (a stricter variant runs at this tier), 'retain' (this rule does NOT apply at this tier).
